provenance.supported_claim: OSCONIQ P 3737 is offered for horticulture with Far Red at nominally 730 nm.

limitations: This preset uses a monochromatic approximation at the nominal wavelength.
It does not reproduce the complete manufacturer spectral power distribution.
Far-red is intentionally reported separately and is not included in OpenGrowTwin PPFD.
Simulation radiant power is not inferred from LED electrical power.
This preset identifies a commercially realistic spectral channel and is not a biological optimum recommendation.
